verdict.rationale: The evidence exclusively shows Shopify in the MCP-server role (exposing Storefront/Order/Catalog MCP servers and UCP endpoints for external AI agents to query commerce data), not Shopify itself acting as an MCP client that ingests third-party MCP servers as tools for its own AI features (e.g., Shopify Magic/Sidekick). No documentation or probe shows a way for a user to plug an external MCP server into Shopify so its own AI can use those tools.
